# DedSec Project — official bilingual website and learning library

> DedSec Project provides a free Android/Termux and Linux toolkit, documentation, programming lessons, troubleshooting, and defensive security education. Public toolkit: https://github.com/dedsec1121fk/DedSec. Ethical and authorized use only.

## Official pages
- [Home / Αρχική](https://ded-sec.space/)
- [Installation / Εγκατάσταση](https://ded-sec.space/Pages/guide-for-installation.html)
- [Tools / Εργαλεία](https://ded-sec.space/Pages/learn-about-the-tools.html)
- [Assistance / Βοήθεια](https://ded-sec.space/Pages/assistance.html)
- [FAQ / Συχνές ερωτήσεις](https://ded-sec.space/Pages/faq.html)
- [TikDev](https://ded-sec.space/TikDev.html)

## Notes
Instructional articles are maintained in paired English/Greek source files. Verify version-specific commands, APIs and permissions against current documentation; avoid implying that all platform-specific examples were executed.
